ez-gfx-bindings.description: Public EzGfx C ABI. This file is manually maintained; generated headers and managed bindings are derived from it.

handle.name: EzGfxContext
handle.doc: Opaque packed u64 context handle (slot+1/generation in bits 0-39).

handle.name: EzGfxSurface
handle.doc: Opaque packed u64 surface handle; child bits index the context identity arena and resolve only as Surface.

handle.name: EzGfxFrame
handle.doc: Opaque generation-, kind-, and owner-validated live frame handle.

handle.name: EzGfxReadbackRequest
handle.doc: Stable process-unique identity for one enqueued readback request.

handle.name: EzGfxShader
handle.doc: Opaque packed u64 shader handle; child bits index the context identity arena and resolve only as Shader.

handle.name: EzGfxCounterBuffer
handle.doc: Opaque packed u64 one-frame counter-buffer handle; child bits index the context identity arena and resolve only as Indirect.

handle.name: EzGfxBuffer
handle.doc: Opaque packed u64 one-frame buffer handle; child bits index the context identity arena and resolve only as Structured.

handle.name: EzGfxVertexHeap
handle.doc: Owner- and generation-validated named vertex-heap handle.

handle.name: EzGfxVertexAllocation
handle.doc: Owner- and generation-validated allocation within a named vertex heap.

handle.name: EzGfxIndexAllocation
handle.doc: Owner- and generation-validated allocation within the global index heap.

handle.name: EzGfxTexture
handle.doc: Opaque packed u64 texture handle; child bits index the context identity arena and resolve only as Texture.

handle.name: EzGfxRenderTarget
handle.doc: Opaque packed u64 render-target handle; child bits index the context identity arena and resolve only as RenderTarget.

enum.name: EzGfxResult
enum.doc: Result returned by context, surface, shader, buffer, and render operations.

value.name: EzGfxResult_InvalidContext
value.doc: The context is null, stale, or does not own the resource.

value.name: EzGfxResult_NotReady
value.doc: The operation is temporarily unavailable, such as a minimized surface.

value.name: EzGfxResult_Unsupported
value.doc: The requested backend or subsystem is unavailable.

value.name: EzGfxResult_DeviceLost
value.doc: The owning device entered terminal lost state.

value.name: EzGfxResult_QueueFull
value.doc: Asynchronous scheduling or staging capacity is unavailable.

value.name: EzGfxResult_Cancelled
value.doc: The asynchronous operation was cancelled before completion.

enum.name: EzGfxTextureError
enum.doc: Result returned by texture loading and unloading.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_InvalidContext
value.doc: The context is null, stale, or does not own the resource.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_InvalidArguments
value.doc: Texture data or description failed validation.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_UnsupportedFormat
value.doc: No registered decoder supports the source format.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_OutOfTextureHandles
value.doc: The texture handle table is full.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_DecodeFailed
value.doc: The image decoder rejected the data.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_WorkerUnavailable
value.doc: No texture upload worker is available.

value.name: EzGfxTextureError_NotFound
value.doc: The texture handle is not loaded.

enum.name: EzGfxUploadResourceKind
enum.doc: Resource family carried by an upload event.

value.name: EzGfxUploadStatus_SourceStaged
value.doc: Caller source bytes are no longer needed.

value.name: EzGfxSurfacePlatform_Headless
value.doc: Windowless Vulkan headless surface; no native handles. Requires ABI 27.

enum.name: EzGfxSourceTextureFormat
enum.doc: Source image encoding; values 128 through 255 are application decoders.

value.name: EzGfxSourceTextureFormat_Dds
value.doc: DDS image bytes with a legacy or DX10 header.

value.name: EzGfxSourceTextureFormat_Raw
value.doc: Tightly packed mip bytes in the destination storage format; the destination must name a concrete format.

enum.name: EzGfxRenderTargetFormat
enum.doc: Render-target storage format; discriminants mirror the runtime format codes.

value.name: EzGfxEventKind_Diagnostic
value.doc: Diagnostic observation; record and level are valid.

value.name: EzGfxEventKind_Readback
value.doc: Completed readback bytes; readback fields are valid.

value.name: EzGfxEventKind_Snapshot
value.doc: Unrequested persistent presentation snapshot; readback fields are valid and request ID is zero.

struct.name: EzGfxAdapterDesc
struct.doc: Explicit adapter request selected by stable identity. Requires ABI 26.

field.name: allow_software
field.doc: Non-zero accepts a software-class adapter; zero or one.

struct.name: EzGfxAdapterInfo
struct.doc: Enumerated adapter identity with admission diagnostics. Requires ABI 26.

field.name: admitted
field.doc: Non-zero when the adapter passes admission under the queried policy.

field.name: software_rejected
field.doc: Non-zero when software policy alone rejects the adapter.

field.name: error_count
field.doc: Count of unmet profile requirements; zero when admitted.

struct.name: EzGfxContextDesc
struct.doc: Context creation options.

field.name: texture_decode_workers
field.doc: Async texture decode threads; zero selects the default topology.

field.name: adapter_count
field.doc: Explicit adapter requests; zero keeps default ranking, one selects by identity. Requires ABI 26.

field.name: adapter
field.doc: Exactly adapter_count explicit requests; null if and only if zero. Requires ABI 26.

struct.name: EzGfxBackendContextDesc
struct.doc: Backend-selecting context creation options.

field.name: texture_decode_workers
field.doc: Async texture decode threads; zero selects the default topology.

field.name: adapter_count
field.doc: Explicit adapter requests; zero keeps default ranking, one selects by identity. Requires ABI 26.

field.name: adapter
field.doc: Exactly adapter_count explicit requests; null if and only if zero. Requires ABI 26.

struct.name: EzGfxSurfaceDesc
struct.doc: Caller-owned native window or Metal layer used to create a presentation surface.

field.name: display
field.doc: Native HINSTANCE; null for Metal and permitted for GLFW.

struct.name: EzGfxShaderDesc
struct.doc: Shader source and stage entry-point metadata.

field.name: path
field.doc: Exactly path_length UTF-8 bytes; no NUL terminator is required.

field.name: vertex_entry
field.doc: Optional exact UTF-8 byte range paired with vertex_entry_length.

field.name: fragment_entry
field.doc: Optional exact UTF-8 byte range paired with fragment_entry_length.

field.name: compute_entry
field.doc: Optional exact UTF-8 byte range paired with compute_entry_length.

struct.name: EzGfxTextureDesc
struct.doc: Texture decoding and sampling metadata.

field.name: width
field.doc: Decoded width for raw pixels and Raw ingestion.

field.name: height
field.doc: Decoded height for raw pixels and Raw ingestion.

field.name: mip_count
field.doc: Number of mip levels, zero for decoder defaults; Raw requires an explicit nonzero count.

field.name: max_anisotropy
field.doc: Requested anisotropy; zero uses the default.

field.name: debug_label
field.doc: Optional exact UTF-8 byte range paired with debug_label_length.

struct.name: EzGfxDecodedTextureMip
struct.doc: One custom-decoder mip retained until release.

struct.name: EzGfxDecodedTexture
struct.doc: Custom decoder output copied before release.

field.name: format
field.doc: Concrete decoded GPU format; Auto is invalid.

struct.name: EzGfxTextureRegionDesc
struct.doc: Borrowed bytes and destination rectangle for one asynchronous texture update.

field.name: data
field.doc: Tightly packed texel or compressed-block bytes; retained only for the call.

struct.name: EzGfxRenderTargetDesc
struct.doc: Render-target name, usage, format candidates, and clear value.

field.name: name
field.doc: Exactly name_length UTF-8 bytes, 1..=255 bytes; no NUL terminator is required.

field.name: relative_scale
field.doc: Scale factor relative to the reference dimensions; finite and positive.

field.name: samples
field.doc: Requested multisample count; one of 1, 2, 4, or 8.

field.name: candidate_formats
field.doc: Exactly candidate_count format codes from EzGfxRenderTargetFormat.

field.name: sampleable
field.doc: Non-zero requires texture-sampling support; zero or one.

field.name: use_clear
field.doc: Non-zero stores clear_color; zero or one.

field.name: clear_color
field.doc: Color clear value read only when use_clear is non-zero.

struct.name: EzGfxTextureUploadTelemetry
struct.doc: Monotonic context-wide asynchronous texture pipeline counters.

field.name: staging_bytes
field.doc: Aggregate bytes admitted to native staging.

struct.name: EzGfxBinding
struct.doc: Shader resource binding.

field.name: name
field.doc: Exactly name_length UTF-8 bytes; no NUL terminator is required.

struct.name: EzGfxDynamicState
struct.doc: Optional dynamic state overrides.

struct.name: EzGfxDrawIndexedCommand
struct.doc: One indexed indirect draw command.

struct.name: EzGfxByteBuffer
struct.doc: Pointer-plus-length byte range for ABI consumers.

field.name: data
field.doc: Byte range; nullable only when length is zero.

struct.name: EzGfxRuntimeRecord
struct.doc: One runtime outcome delivered to the context callback.

field.name: resource
field.doc: Related opaque resource handle, or zero.

struct.name: EzGfxUploadEvent
struct.doc: One lossless typed upload transition.

field.name: resource
field.doc: Opaque typed resource or allocation handle.

struct.name: EzGfxDiagnostic
struct.doc: One bounded local diagnostic and its causal record.

struct.name: EzGfxEvent
struct.doc: One tagged graphics event for the registered context callback. Only the kind-selected payload is valid; readback bytes are borrowed for the invocation.

field.name: record
field.doc: Runtime or diagnostic record; valid for Runtime or Diagnostic.

field.name: readback_request_id
field.doc: Stable request correlator, or zero for an unrequested snapshot.

field.name: readback_texture
field.doc: Source texture, or zero for a surface snapshot.

field.name: readback_width
field.doc: Image width; valid for Readback or Snapshot.

field.name: readback_height
field.doc: Image height; valid for Readback or Snapshot.

field.name: readback_byte_count
field.doc: Byte count; valid for Readback or Snapshot.

field.name: readback_bytes
field.doc: Borrowed RGBA bytes, valid for the callback invocation only.

struct.name: EzGfxHandleParts
struct.doc: Decoded fields of an opaque packed handle.

field.name: child_slot
field.doc: Child-resource arena slot; zero for a context handle.

field.name: child_generation
field.doc: Child-resource slot generation; zero for a context handle.

field.name: is_context
field.doc: Non-zero when the handle refers directly to a context.

function.name: ez_gfx_abi_version
function.doc: Returns the ABI version implemented by the native library.

returns.doc: ABI version; no context is required.

function.name: ez_gfx_print_error
function.doc: Writes the stable message for a result code into caller-owned storage.

param.name: result
param.doc: Result byte to describe; unknown values produce 'unknown error'.

param.name: buffer
param.doc: Caller-owned UTF-8 output; null only for a zero-capacity size query.

param.name: capacity
param.doc: Writable output bytes, or zero for a size query.

param.name: out_required
param.doc: Required bytes including the trailing NUL.

returns.doc: Returns Ok, or InvalidArgument for an invalid pointer/capacity pair or insufficient storage.

function.name: ez_gfx_context_create
function.doc: Creates a Vulkan context and instance.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a creation error.

function.name: ez_gfx_context_create_backend
function.doc: Creates a context for an explicit native backend.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a validation, admission, or native error.

function.name: ez_gfx_adapter_count
function.doc: Counts enumerated adapters without creating anything. Requires ABI 26.

param.name: out_count
param.doc: Receives the number of enumerated adapters.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or EzGfxResult_InvalidArgument.

function.name: ez_gfx_adapters_query
function.doc: Enumerates adapters with admission diagnostics without creating anything. Requires ABI 26.

param.name: allow_software
param.doc: Non-zero admits software-class adapters in the diagnosis; zero or one.

param.name: out_adapters
param.doc: Receives at most capacity entries; null if and only if capacity is zero.

param.name: capacity
param.doc: Writable entry count of out_adapters; zero queries the total with a null buffer.

param.name: out_written
param.doc: Receives entries written, or the total when capacity is zero.

function.name: ez_gfx_context_wait_idle
function.doc: Waits for all context GPU work to become idle without destroying resources.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or an invalid-context, not-ready, native-failure, or device-loss result.

function.name: ez_gfx_context_destroy
function.doc: Waits for an initialized device to become idle, then destroys a context and all native resources it owns. A context without a device is destroyed without waiting. Cleanup is terminal once it begins.

param.name: context
param.doc: Context to destroy on its creator thread; null, stale, repeated, and wrong-thread calls are ignored.

returns.doc: No return value; wait or release failures cannot be reported through the stable ABI.

function.name: ez_gfx_surface_create
function.doc: Creates a native presentation surface for a caller-owned window or Metal layer.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a validation/native error.

function.name: ez_gfx_context_init_device
function.doc: Initializes the context device using a created surface.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a native failure.

function.name: ez_gfx_surface_resize
function.doc: Updates the host-observed surface extent and minimized state.

param.name: width
param.doc: New width; zero is valid only with zero height for minimized state.

param.name: height
param.doc: New height; zero is valid only with zero width for minimized state.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok, EzGfxResult_NotReady, or an error.

function.name: ez_gfx_shader_load_artifact
function.doc: Loads validated compiler-produced shader artifact bytes without a runtime compiler.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or validation/native failure.

function.name: ez_gfx_shader_destroy
function.doc: Destroys native shader modules/libraries.

returns.doc: No return value; stale handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_load
function.doc: Decodes image/container bytes and starts asynchronous GPU upload.

returns.doc: Returns queueing, validation, decode, or support status.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_decoder_register
function.doc: Registers one concurrent application decoder for source codes 128 through 255.

param.name: user_data
param.doc: Application state retained through unregister and accepted work.

returns.doc: Returns Ok or InvalidArgument.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_decoder_unregister
function.doc: Unregisters one custom decoder.

returns.doc: Returns Ok or InvalidArgument.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_cancel
function.doc: Cancels a texture before or after transfer-worker admission without waiting for GPU completion.

returns.doc: Returns Ok when cancellation wins, or InvalidArgument for a terminal or stale request.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_get_binding
function.doc: Returns the stable binding after upload completion.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_NotReady while upload remains in flight.

function.name: ez_gfx_update_texture_region
function.doc: Copies and asynchronously uploads one validated texture sub-rectangle.

returns.doc: Returns Ok on admission, QueueFull when scheduling or staging capacity is unavailable, or validation/native status.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_get_upload_telemetry
function.doc: Returns monotonic context-wide asynchronous texture pipeline counters.

returns.doc: Returns Ok or context/device status.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_get_residency
function.doc: Reports completed mip residency and the immutable decoded mip count.

param.name: out_resident_mips
param.doc: Receives completed mip count, possibly zero while uploads are pending.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a validation or handle status.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_set_residency
function.doc: Sets the contiguous coarse mip count exposed through the stable texture binding.

returns.doc: Returns Ok when published, NotReady while uploads or safe descriptor rewrites remain pending, or a validation or handle status.

function.name: ez_gfx_texture_unload
function.doc: Invalidates and releases a texture.

returns.doc: No return value; null or stale handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_render_target_create
function.doc: Creates a managed render target from a declaration and explicit extents.

param.name: desc
param.doc: Target name, usage, candidates, and clear value.

returns.doc: Returns Ok, Unsupported for depth/storage/multisample, or validation/native status.

function.name: ez_gfx_render_target_destroy
function.doc: Destroys a render target and clears any bound override.

returns.doc: No return value; null or stale handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_render_target_get_format
function.doc: Reports the resolved storage format code of a live render target.

param.name: out_format
param.doc: Receives the format code from EzGfxRenderTargetFormat.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a validation or handle status.

function.name: ez_gfx_render_target_get_extent
function.doc: Reports the extents of a live render target.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a validation or handle status.

function.name: ez_gfx_render_target_get_clear
function.doc: Reports the stored clear value of a live render target.

param.name: out_color
param.doc: Receives four color components; zeros when no clear is stored.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a validation or handle status.

function.name: ez_gfx_render_target_probe_format
function.doc: Probes whether one format admits a sampled color target at the given sample count.

param.name: samples
param.doc: Requested multisample count; one of 1, 2, 4, or 8.

returns.doc: Returns Ok when resolvable, Unsupported otherwise, or validation status.

function.name: ez_gfx_render_target_frame_begin
function.doc: Begins frame recording against a managed render target.

returns.doc: Returns state, handle, or capability status.

function.name: ez_gfx_frame_begin
function.doc: Begins one presented-surface frame.

returns.doc: Returns readiness or handle status.

function.name: ez_gfx_counter_buffer_acquire
function.doc: Acquires a context-owned one-frame counter buffer.

returns.doc: Returns validation or allocation status.

function.name: ez_gfx_counter_buffer_write_draws
function.doc: Writes a contiguous draw-command range before consumption.

param.name: commands
param.doc: Contiguous command data; null only when count is zero.

returns.doc: Returns ownership, overflow, or bounds status.

function.name: ez_gfx_counter_buffer_publish_count
function.doc: Publishes a CPU-known visible count before consumption.

returns.doc: Returns ownership or bounds status.

function.name: ez_gfx_counter_buffer_release
function.doc: Releases an unconsumed counter buffer.

param.name: buffer
param.doc: Counter buffer; zero and stale values are ignored.

returns.doc: No return value; stale and zero handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_render_add_vertex_pipeline
function.doc: Records a graphics pipeline and indexed-indirect draw.

param.name: buffer
param.doc: Counter buffer consumed by this frame for indirect commands.

returns.doc: Returns validation or native status.

function.name: ez_gfx_render_add_compute_pipeline
function.doc: Records a compute pipeline dispatch.

returns.doc: Returns validation or native status.

function.name: ez_gfx_graph_enqueue_texture_readback
function.doc: Compiles and enqueues a texture-readback graph node and returns its callback correlator.

returns.doc: Returns graph, handle, or output-pointer status.

function.name: ez_gfx_frame_end
function.doc: Consumes, submits, and conditionally presents a live frame.

returns.doc: Returns submission or presentation status; every result invalidates the handle.

function.name: ez_gfx_frame_abort
function.doc: Consumes a live frame without submitting it.

returns.doc: Returns abort status; every result invalidates the handle.

function.name: ez_gfx_callback_register
function.doc: Replaces the owner-thread context event callback and delivers pending events.

param.name: callback
param.doc: Callback to install; null clears the registration.

param.name: user_data
param.doc: Application state borrowed only during callback invocation.

returns.doc: Returns context, callback, or dispatch status.

function.name: ez_gfx_surface_get_extent
function.doc: Reads the current framebuffer extent.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_NotReady while minimized.

function.name: ez_gfx_surface_resize_pending
function.doc: Reports whether a parent-observed resize is pending.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or an error.

function.name: ez_gfx_surface_set_snapshot_cache
function.doc: Updates the snapshot-cache preference.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a validation error.

function.name: ez_gfx_vertex_heap_create
function.doc: Creates a named device-local vertex heap and returns its typed handle.

returns.doc: Returns validation, allocation, or native status.

function.name: ez_gfx_vertex_heap_destroy
function.doc: Destroys the vertex heap selected by its typed handle.

returns.doc: Stale and foreign handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_vertex_upload_indices
function.doc: Uploads u32 indices and returns a typed allocation.

returns.doc: Returns upload or validation status.

function.name: ez_gfx_vertex_upload
function.doc: Uploads vertices to a typed heap and returns a typed allocation.

returns.doc: Returns upload, ownership, or validation status.

function.name: ez_gfx_vertex_allocation_get_range
function.doc: Queries a live vertex allocation range.

returns.doc: Returns validation or ownership status.

function.name: ez_gfx_index_allocation_get_range
function.doc: Queries a live index allocation range.

returns.doc: Returns validation or ownership status.

function.name: ez_gfx_vertex_allocation_remove
function.doc: Removes a live vertex allocation using its recorded heap owner.

returns.doc: Returns validation or ownership status.

function.name: ez_gfx_index_allocation_remove
function.doc: Removes a live index allocation after GPU safety.

returns.doc: Returns validation or ownership status.

function.name: ez_gfx_buffer_acquire
function.doc: Acquires a context-owned one-frame structured buffer.

returns.doc: Returns validation or allocation status.

function.name: ez_gfx_buffer_write
function.doc: Copies a validated element range before consumption.

param.name: data
param.doc: Element bytes; null only when count is zero.

returns.doc: Returns validation, ownership, or range status.

function.name: ez_gfx_buffer_release
function.doc: Releases an unconsumed buffer.

param.name: buffer
param.doc: Buffer handle; zero and stale values are ignored.

returns.doc: Stale handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_surface_destroy
function.doc: Destroys a surface while leaving its parent window untouched.

returns.doc: No return value; null handles are ignored.

function.name: ez_gfx_handle_inspect
function.doc: Decodes a packed handle without requiring a live context.

param.name: out_parts
param.doc: Receives context and optional child slot generations.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or a handle validation error.

function.name: ez_gfx_semantic_id
function.doc: Computes the fixed 16-byte identifier for a canonical semantic name.

param.name: name
param.doc: Exact ASCII dot-separated name bytes; each non-empty segment starts with a letter and continues with letters, digits, or underscores; embedded NUL is invalid.

param.name: length
param.doc: Name byte count in the inclusive range 1..255.

returns.doc: Returns EzGfxResult_Ok or EzGfxResult_InvalidArgument.
